title: functional suffixes are postfix forms inside operators, arguments and conditions
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

provenance.expected_basis: grammar: arrow_suffix is a postfix form of a map/filter/reduce member call. 100+10=110; one element >3; not all-true is false; 4 + (1+4+9+16)=34; nested sums 2+4+6+8=20; bool.string() spells true/false as 1/0.
